sloka: एमुक्त्वा विमानस्थश्चैत्यस्थान् हरियूथपः ।ननाद भीमनिर्ह्रादो रक्षसां जनयन् भयम् ।।। ५.४३.१२।।।।
transliteration: emuktvā vimānasthaścaityasthān hariyūthapaḥ ।nanāda bhīmanirhrādo rakṣasāṁ janayan bhayam ।।। 5.43.12।।।।

translations.english: 'I shall return only after accomplishing the destruction of the city of Lanka and offering obeisance to Sita, while all demons keep looking at me'.
